preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMaxTxAmount(1) to set the maximum transaction amount to the minimum possible value (1 wei). This will effectively stop all user transactions (except the owner's) since the _transfer function checks if amount <= _maxTxAmount for non-owner transactions. The owner remains unaffected because the check only applies when from != owner() && to != owner().
